## Context

- Design (D25): Project v2 under Programming-Made-EZ named `Phrase Board`, PRIVATE (the product owner views it logged in on their phone; the issue text is already public in the repo; making the project public is a one-word ask for the product owner and the scripts have no public setting). Fields: Rank, Card number, Depends on, Kind, Phase, Card author, plus Status (GitHub reserves the names Type, Milestone and Author, found on the real apply) (Ready, In Progress, Done, Superseded/Withdrawn); the built-in close-sets-Done workflow is off. Tooling cards whose code runs in mob-defaults are still issues in phrase-lang. A card is Done only when its Done-when passes and a non-author reviewed it; a bare issue close never implies Done.
- Safety: the migration and picker scripts use only the `gh` token's `project`, `repo` and `read:org` scopes, against `Programming-Made-EZ/phrase-lang` and its ONE project; they NEVER delete issues, comments, items or the project, never edit an issue without the `<!-- phrase-card:NNN -->` marker, never change visibility, permissions, workflows or secrets, and never touch play-tracker, mob-defaults' GitHub repo or any other mob; the default is `--dry-run`, apply refuses any other owner or repo, and a second apply creates nothing; each card is smoke-tested on a fake `gh` before any real apply.
- Phrase board and docs (read-only, absolute paths): cards in `C:\Users\ringe\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-ringe\73298da3-f8ff-4a30-af55-b3e95ffa16f4\scratchpad\wt-push4\board\`, `VISION.md` and `docs\` under `C:\Users\ringe\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-ringe\73298da3-f8ff-4a30-af55-b3e95ffa16f4\scratchpad\wt-push4\`.
- Tests first with the fake `gh`; Windows and PowerShell quoting traps apply (write scripts to files, no nested quoting).
